06/09/21 Bug fix update
Chromatic Fantasy original soundtrack
notes.content:
The soundtrack for the game created by John Chow Seymour includes 18 music tracks inspired by classic compositions. The music not only complements the gameplay and creates a mood for exploring mysterious dungeons and solving puzzles in a fantasy world, but is also a brilliant self-contained piece.

The soundtrack album is available now on bandcamp:
https://johnchowseymour.bandcamp.com/album/chromatic-fantasy-ost
